messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: They have to manually call each supplier to see garage repair progress, which interrupts their work.
  quote: We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.
- problem: The team lacks built‑in visibility of garage progress and must make phone calls to get updates.
  quote: we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls
- problem: Handlers have to manually move garage estimates out of correspondence, which creates delays.
  quote: we’ve got some handlers still manually moving garage estimates out of correspondence, and it’s causing delays.
- problem: They lack live repair status updates, forcing them to repeatedly call suppliers and causing daily workflow blockages.
  quote: We’re constantly phoning suppliers because there’s no live repair status, which is a daily blocker for us.
- problem: Missing repair updates force the team to stop work and call suppliers, breaking their workflow.
  quote: It’s a real drag — every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow ... because repair updates missing means no visibility.
- problem: The system lacks live repair updates, forcing manual calls to garages.
  quote: Also, we’re still stuck calling garages manually because the system doesn’t show live repair updates — it’s a daily headache... The repair updates missing is a daily blocker — we have to call every garage to get status, which interrupts our handling workflow and delays settlements.
- problem: Customers cannot see live repair updates, forcing them to call garages daily.
  quote: Also, repair updates missing — we’re on the phone daily with garages because there’s no live status.
- problem: The system does not provide live updates from garages, causing daily frustration.
  quote: Good morning, Deryn. I’m calling about our team’s daily frustrations with the system’s lack of live updates from garages.
